meta.description: Everything you need for your stay: how to get here, house rules, WiFi, and the best of Valencia.

hero.propertyName: A room steps from Turia Park
hero.subtitle: Your quick guide for a smooth, happy stay in Valencia.

howToGetThere.title: How to get here
howToGetThere.intro: Our address and the easiest ways to reach us from the airport, the train station, or the bus station.

fromAirport.title: From Valencia Airport (VLC)
fromAirport.text: The best option is the metro: take Line 3 or Line 5 to Nou d'Octubre station (about 15 minutes). From there, walk a few meters to the stop and take bus 98 towards Passeig Marítim - Hospital Malva-rosa, which drops you just a 2-minute walk from the apartment. The whole trip takes around 35-40 minutes from the airport. If you'd rather go direct, a taxi takes about 20 minutes.

fromTrainStation.title: From Estación del Norte
fromTrainStation.text: The apartment is about a 20-minute walk, or a quick ride with the EMT bus network, taxi, or rideshare app.

fromBusStation.title: From Valencia Bus Station
fromBusStation.text: The bus station is just 400m from the apartment, about a 5-minute walk.

houseRules.title: House rules
houseRules.intro: A few things to keep in mind so everyone has a great stay.

smoking.label: Smoking / vaping
smoking.value: Not inside the room or common areas — allowed on the balcony

cancellation.label: Cancellation policy
cancellation.value: Moderate for short stays, firm for long stays

houseRules.kitchenNote: For hygiene reasons, cooking on the ceramic hob isn't allowed — you're welcome to use the microwave or air fryer.
houseRules.laundryNote: The washing machine has an extra cost and can only be used between 10:00 AM and 8:00 PM to avoid disturbing neighbors — let us know beforehand so we can set it up with the right program and products.
houseRules.dryingNote: If you'd like to hang up laundry, please do it on the drying rack in the laundry room, not from the bedroom window: clothes hung outside can only be taken down by going back into that room, which can get awkward later on.
houseRules.bathroomNote: Please help keep the bathroom clean after use: "Leave it as you'd like to find it."
houseRules.petNote: Uma, a very affectionate 9-year-old French Bulldog, lives in the flat and will likely greet you with excitement. Please keep this in mind before booking if you're afraid of or dislike dogs.

attractions.title: Discover Valencia
attractions.intro: A few classics worth your time while you're here.

cityOfArtsAndSciences.title: City of Arts and Sciences
cityOfArtsAndSciences.address: Av. del Professor López Piñero, 7, Valencia
cityOfArtsAndSciences.travelInfo: ~20 min walk, or Metro L3/L5 to Alameda + 10 min walk
cityOfArtsAndSciences.description: Valencia's futuristic icon: science museum, opera house, planetarium, and Europe's largest aquarium, all in one riverbed park.

centralMarket.title: Mercado Central
centralMarket.address: Plaça de la Ciutat de València, s/n, Valencia
centralMarket.travelInfo: ~15 min walk, or Metro to Xàtiva
centralMarket.description: A stunning modernist market hall packed with fresh produce, jamón, and local tapas bars — great for breakfast or a snack.

elCarmen.title: El Carmen (Old Town)
elCarmen.travelInfo: ~20 min walk, or short taxi ride
elCarmen.description: Valencia's oldest neighborhood: narrow medieval streets, street art, and buzzing tapas bars into the night.

malvarrossaBeach.title: Playa de la Malvarrosa
malvarrossaBeach.address: Passeig Marítim de la Malva-rosa, Valencia
malvarrossaBeach.travelInfo: ~25 min by bus or a short taxi/bike ride
malvarrossaBeach.description: The city's main sandy beach, lined with paella restaurants right on the seafront.

lonjaDeLaSeda.title: La Lonja de la Seda
lonjaDeLaSeda.description: A UNESCO World Heritage Gothic silk exchange, one of the finest examples of civil Gothic architecture in Europe.

turiaGardens.title: Turia Gardens
turiaGardens.travelInfo: Right outside — a few minutes' walk
turiaGardens.description: A 9km park built in the old riverbed, perfect for walking, running, or cycling straight from the door.

termasDeMura.title: Roman Baths and Oracular Sanctuary of Mura (Llíria)
termasDeMura.travelInfo: Half-day trip: ~35 min by car, or Metrovalencia Line 2 to Llíria + a short local ride
termasDeMura.description: One of the largest Roman thermal complexes on the peninsula (1st century AD), with a rare oracular sanctuary — an archaeological day trip about 30km from Valencia.

portSaplaya.title: Port Saplaya
portSaplaya.travelInfo: ~15-20 min by car or taxi, also reachable by tram Line 4
portSaplaya.description: Known as Valencia's "little Venice": canals with moored boats and colorful seafront houses, perfect for a relaxed stroll.

sanNicolas.title: San Nicolás Parish-Museum
sanNicolas.travelInfo: ~20 min walk, in the El Carmen neighborhood
sanNicolas.description: Known as the "Valencian Sistine Chapel": almost 2,000 m² of Baroque frescoes completely cover its Gothic vaults.

ateneaSky.title: Atenea Sky ✢ Rooftop
ateneaSky.travelInfo: ~20 min walk or a short taxi/bus ride, in the historic center
ateneaSky.description: A rooftop terrace on the 8th floor of the historic Ateneo Mercantil building, with 360° city views and great cocktails.

skyBarNovotel.title: Sky Bar Novotel Valencia Levante
skyBarNovotel.travelInfo: ~15 min by bus or taxi, next to the Nuevo Centro shopping mall
skyBarNovotel.description: A rooftop terrace with a pool on the 12th floor of the Novotel hotel, free entry, with 360° panoramic city views.

bombasGens.title: Bombas Gens Centre d'Art
bombasGens.travelInfo: A few minutes' walk along Av. de Burjassot, very close to the apartment
bombasGens.description: A contemporary art and photography center set in a renovated 1930s Art Déco factory — free entry on select days.

ivam.title: IVAM (Valencian Institute of Modern Art)
ivam.address: Carrer de Guillem de Castro, 118, Valencia
ivam.travelInfo: ~10 min by bus, or ~25 min walking along the Turia Gardens
ivam.description: Spain's first modern art museum (1989), home to an outstanding collection of Julio González sculptures.

miradorAlbufera.title: Mirador de la Albufera
miradorAlbufera.address: Between El Saler and El Palmar, Valencia
miradorAlbufera.travelInfo: Half-day trip: ~20 min by car or taxi, about 10 km south of the city
miradorAlbufera.description: One of the most beautiful sunsets in Spain, over the Albufera lake surrounded by rice paddies. Great for birdwatching — the Albufera is a special protection area with over 300 species — or a traditional boat ride.

valenbici.title: Valenbici (bike rental)
valenbici.travelInfo: Download the app and sign up; short-term passes available for tourists
valenbici.description: Valencia's public bike-share system — a cheap, fast way to get around the flat, bike-friendly city.

yego.title: Yego (moto-sharing)
yego.address: Available across the city via the app
yego.travelInfo: Download the app, verify your license, and unlock a scooter nearby
yego.description: A moto-sharing service that's ideal for zipping around Valencia without worrying about traffic or parking.

emt.title: EMT Valencia (buses & metro)
emt.travelInfo: Check schedules, routes, and real-time arrivals
emt.description: The official EMT app for getting around by bus and checking the metro — handy for planning trips around the city.
